metadata.question: Did the water extent in Lake Killamperpunna increase between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did the water extent in Lake Killamperpunna increase between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?" We need to: 1. Define Lake Killamperpunna geometry (point/polygon). 2. Use satellite imagery (Sentinel-2 preferred) to detect water for two periods: - Period 1: Around June 20, 2025 (e.g., June 15-25) - Period 2: Around September 15, 2025 (e.g., September 10-20) 3. Compute water extent (pixel count of water) for each period. 4. Compare: if water pixels in Period 2 > Period 1, answer "A: Yes", else "B: No". 5. Handle edge cases: No images (C1), no valid pixels (C2), calculation failure (C3). Approach: - Use Sentinel-2 MSI (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for 2025 data. - Apply cloud masking using QA60 band. - Compute NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) = (B3 - B8) / (B3 + B8) for water detection. - Threshold NDWI > 0 to identify water pixels. - Count water pixels in the lake region for each period composite (median). - If Sentinel-2 fails (no images), fallback to Landsat 8/9. Important considerations: - Dates are in 2025 (future relative to 2024). We assume data might be available by 2025, but if not, we'll get empty collections and try fallback. - Lake location: Lake Killamperpunna is in South Australia. Coordinates approximately: -27.5, 136.5. We'll create a buffer around a point. - Use appropriate scale (e.g., 20m for Sentinel-2) and maxPixels to avoid memory issues. - Print concise stats: number of images in each period, water pixel counts. - Final output one of the tags: A, B, C1, C2, C3, or D. Structure: 1. Define geometry and time periods. 2. Function to get water pixel count for a given period. a. Try Sentinel-2 first. b. If no images, try Landsat 8/9. c. Apply cloud masking, compute NDWI, threshold, count water pixels. 3. Call function for both periods. 4. Compare counts and output answer. We must check: - If collection size is 0 after trying fallbacks -> C1. - If valid pixel count is 0 -> C2. - If result is NaN or invalid -> C3. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakePoint = ee.Geometry.Point([136.5, -27.5]); // Lake Killamperpunna, SA const lakeRegion = lakePoint.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer to cover lake area const period1Start = '2025-06-15'; const period1End = '2025-06-25'; const period2Start = '2025-09-10'; const period2End = '2025-09-20'; // Function to get water pixel count for a given period async function getWaterPixelCount(startDate, endDate) { // Try Sentinel-2 first let s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeRegion) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); let size = s2.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 9 let ls9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeRegion) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); size = ls9.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 8 let ls8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeRegion) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); size = ls8.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return {count: null, images: 0, collection: null, source: 'none'}; } else { var collection = ls8; var source = 'Landsat8'; } } else { var collection = ls9; var source = 'Landsat9'; } } else { var collection = s2; var source = 'Sentinel2'; } // Cloud masking function based on source function maskClouds(img) { if (source === 'Sentinel2') { // Sentinel-2: Use QA60 for clouds let qa = img.select('QA60'); let cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; let cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; let mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask); } else { // Landsat 8/9: Use QA_PIXEL for clouds let qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); let cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // snow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // clouds return img.updateMask(cloudMask); } } // Apply cloud masking and create median composite let composite = collection.map(maskClouds).median(); // Compute NDWI for water detection let ndwi; if (source === 'Sentinel2') { // Sentinel-2: Green = B3, NIR = B8 ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']); } else { // Landsat: Green = SR_B3, NIR = SR_B5 ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']); } // Threshold NDWI > 0 for water let waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels in the lake region let count = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeRegion, scale: 20, // Use 20m scale for efficiency maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('nd').getInfo(); return {count: count, images: size, collection: collection, source: source}; } // 2. Get water pixel counts for both periods let result1 = await getWaterPixelCount(period1Start, period1End); let result2 = await getWaterPixelCount(period2Start, period2End); // 3. Check for no data (C1) if (result1.images === 0 || result2.images === 0) { console.log(`June period images: ${result1.images} (${result1.source})`); console.log(`Sept period images: ${result2.images} (${result2.source})`); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (result1.count === 0 || result2.count === 0) { console.log(`June water pixels: ${result1.count}`); console.log(`Sept water pixels: ${result2.count}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Check for calculation failure (C3) if (result1.count === null || result2.count === null || isNaN(result1.count) || isNaN(result2.count)) { console.log(`June result: ${result1.count}`); console.log(`Sept result: ${result2.count}`); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Compare and output final answer console.log(`June (${result1.source}): ${result1.images} images, Water pixels: ${result1.count}`); console.log(`Sept (${result2.source}): ${result2.images} images, Water pixels: ${result2.count}`); console.log(`Change: ${result2.count - result1.count} pixels`); if (result2.count > result1.count) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
